body.message:
Apologies for the delay.

We understand your request and have reviewed it with management, and the contract has been updated accordingly.

However, please note that the unit you previously viewed has now been reserved by another confirmed booking. Therefore, we regret that we are unable to accommodate you in the same apartment.

That said, we do have an alternative unit available. If you would like to view this option, we would be happy to arrange a viewing at your convenience.
